summaryId: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 memiliki celah Path Traversal dan pengungkapan file di luar document root apabila konfigurasi 'Require all granted' tidak diaktifkan.
summaryEn: A flaw in path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows an attacker to use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives.
remediationId: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server ke versi 2.4.51 atau versi terbaru.
remediationEn: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later.

summaryId: Perbaikan CVE-2021-41773 pada Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 tidak lengkap, memungkinkan Path Traversal dan potensi Remote Code Execution jika mod_cgi aktif.
summaryEn: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50 allows path traversal and potential RCE when CGI scripts are enabled.
remediationId: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server minimal ke versi 2.4.51 atau 2.4.62+.
remediationEn: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to at least 2.4.51 or 2.4.62+.

summaryId: Konfigurasi mod_proxy tertentu pada Apache HTTP Server 2.4.0 hingga 2.4.55 rentan terhadap HTTP Request Smuggling.
summaryEn: Some mod_proxy configurations on Apache HTTP Server versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.55 allow a HTTP Request Smuggling attack.
remediationId: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server ke versi 2.4.56 atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.56 or later.

summaryId: Kerentanan pada pemrosesan output backend di Apache HTTP Server <= 2.4.59 dapat mengakibatkan eksekusi skrip lokal atau kebocoran informasi.
summaryEn: Vulnerability in core of Apache HTTP Server 2.4.59 and earlier allows malicious or exploitable backend output to trigger internal redirects to local handlers.
remediationId: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server ke versi 2.4.60 atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.60 or later.

summaryId: Kerentanan off-by-one pada resolver DNS nginx (0.6.18 - 1.20.0) saat memproses respons DNS.
summaryEn: A security issue in nginx resolver (0.6.18 - 1.20.0) allows an off-by-one heap write via crafted DNS responses when the 'resolver' directive is used.
remediationId: Upgrade nginx ke versi 1.20.1, 1.21.0, atau cabang mainline/stable terbaru.
remediationEn: Upgrade nginx to version 1.20.1, 1.21.0, or latest stable release.

summaryId: Kerentanan korupsi memori pada modul ngx_http_mp4_module di nginx sebelum 1.22.1 / 1.23.2.
summaryEn: Memory corruption in nginx ngx_http_mp4_module before 1.22.1 / 1.23.2 via specially crafted mp4 file.
remediationId: Upgrade nginx ke versi 1.22.1 / 1.23.2 atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Upgrade nginx to version 1.22.1 / 1.23.2 or later.

summaryId: Kerentanan crash worker process pada ngx_http_mp4_module di nginx sebelum 1.26.2.
summaryEn: Buffer over-read in nginx ngx_http_mp4_module before 1.26.2 can cause worker process termination.
remediationId: Upgrade nginx ke versi 1.26.2 atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Upgrade nginx to version 1.26.2 or later.

summaryId: Kerentanan CGI Argument Injection pada PHP (< 8.1.29, < 8.2.20, < 8.3.8) yang memungkinkan eksekusi kode jarak jauh pada sistem tertentu.
summaryEn: PHP CGI Argument Injection vulnerability (< 8.1.29, < 8.2.20, < 8.3.8) allowing remote code execution via character encoding conversion.
remediationId: Upgrade PHP ke versi 8.1.29+, 8.2.20+, atau 8.3.8+.
remediationEn: Upgrade PHP to version 8.1.29+, 8.2.20+, or 8.3.8+.

summaryId: Kerentanan injeksi cookie jaringan pada PHP sebelum 7.4.32, 8.0.24, dan 8.1.11.
summaryEn: Network and same-site cookie injection flaw in PHP before 7.4.32, 8.0.24, and 8.1.11.
remediationId: Upgrade PHP ke versi rilis keamanan terbaru.
remediationEn: Upgrade PHP to a supported patched release.

summaryId: Laravel sebelum 10.48.23 dan 11.31.0 rentan terhadap manipulasi variabel environment request melalui query string apabila direktif PHP 'register_argc_argv' aktif.
summaryEn: Laravel versions prior to 10.48.23 and 11.31.0 allow environment manipulation via crafted query strings when PHP 'register_argc_argv' is enabled.
remediationId: Perbarui framework Laravel ke >= 11.31.0 / 10.48.23 dan pastikan 'register_argc_argv = Off' pada php.ini.
remediationEn: Upgrade Laravel to >= 11.31.0 / 10.48.23 and set 'register_argc_argv = Off' in php.ini.

summaryId: Facade Ignition pada Laravel <= 8.4.2 dengan APP_DEBUG=true rentan terhadap Remote Code Execution melalui pemrosesan Phar deserialization.
summaryEn: Facade Ignition before 2.5.2 in Laravel <= 8.4.2 with APP_DEBUG=true allows unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via insecure Phar deserialization.
remediationId: Pastikan APP_DEBUG=false di produksi dan perbarui laravel/framework serta facade/ignition (atau spatie/laravel-ignition).
remediationEn: Ensure APP_DEBUG=false in production and update laravel/framework and ignition packages.

summaryId: Laravel Livewire v3 sebelum 3.5.2 memiliki kelemahan validasi ekstensi saat mengunggah file sementara yang dapat memicu risiko eksekusi file.
summaryEn: Laravel Livewire v3 prior to 3.5.2 contains a file extension validation bypass in temporary file uploads.
remediationId: Perbarui paket livewire/livewire minimal ke versi 3.5.2.
remediationEn: Update livewire/livewire to version 3.5.2 or later.

summaryId: Symfony Security sebelum 5.4.46, 6.4.14, dan 7.1.7 memungkinkan bypass autentikasi melalui cookie remember-me yang dimodifikasi.
summaryEn: Symfony Security before 5.4.46, 6.4.14, and 7.1.7 allows authentication bypass via crafted remember-me cookies.
remediationId: Perbarui symfony/security-http ke versi 6.4.14+ atau 7.1.7+.
remediationEn: Update symfony/security-http to version 6.4.14+ or 7.1.7+.

summaryId: Server HTTP/2 berbasis Go (net/http & golang.org/x/net/http2) sebelum Go 1.21.3 / 1.20.10 rentan terhadap serangan HTTP/2 Rapid Reset (CVE-2023-44487) yang menguras CPU.
summaryEn: Go net/http and golang.org/x/net/http2 servers prior to Go 1.21.3 / 1.20.10 are vulnerable to HTTP/2 Rapid Reset stream cancellation resource exhaustion.
remediationId: Kompilasi ulang binary Go menggunakan Go >= 1.22+ dan golang.org/x/net terbaru.
remediationEn: Rebuild the Go binary with Go >= 1.22+ and update golang.org/x/net.

summaryId: Paket net/netip pada Go sebelum 1.21.11 dan 1.22.4 salah mengklasifikasikan alamat IPv4-mapped IPv6 pada fungsi IsPrivate/IsLoopback, yang dapat melewati kebijakan kontrol akses jaringan.
summaryEn: Go net/netip prior to 1.21.11 and 1.22.4 mishandles IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses in IsPrivate/IsLoopback, potentially bypassing IP allowlists or SSRF filters.
remediationId: Perbarui toolchain Go ke versi >= 1.22.4 / 1.23+.
remediationEn: Update the Go toolchain to >= 1.22.4 / 1.23+.

summaryId: Traefik sebelum 2.11.9 dan 3.1.3 tidak menghapus header tertentu yang tercantum dalam header Connection sebelum meneruskan request ke backend.
summaryEn: Traefik prior to 2.11.9 and 3.1.3 mishandles hop-by-hop headers listed in the Connection header when forwarding requests.
remediationId: Upgrade Traefik ke versi 2.11.9+ atau 3.1.3+.
remediationEn: Upgrade Traefik to version 2.11.9+ or 3.1.3+.

summaryId: Layanan web berbasis Rust yang menggunakan pustaka TLS 'rustls' (< 0.23.5, < 0.22.4, < 0.21.11) rentan terhadap infinite loop (DoS) saat menerima pesan TLS ClientHello tertentu.
summaryEn: Rust web services using rustls (< 0.23.5, < 0.22.4, < 0.21.11) can enter an infinite loop when processing crafted TLS handshakes.
remediationId: Perbarui crate rustls pada Cargo.lock ke >= 0.23.5 dan kompilasi ulang binary Rust.
remediationEn: Update the rustls crate in Cargo.lock to >= 0.23.5 and rebuild the Rust binary.

summaryId: Pustaka HTTP Rust 'hyper' sebelum 0.14.25 (digunakan oleh Axum, Warp, dan Tower) rentan terhadap pengurasan memori saat memproses header HTTP/1 yang sangat besar.
summaryEn: The Rust 'hyper' HTTP library prior to 0.14.25 is susceptible to resource exhaustion when parsing stacked HTTP/1 headers.
remediationId: Perbarui crate hyper ke >= 0.14.25 atau 1.x.
remediationEn: Update the hyper crate to >= 0.14.25 or 1.x.

summaryId: Framework Rust actix-web / actix-http pada versi lama memiliki celah pemrosesan Content-Length dan Transfer-Encoding yang dapat memicu HTTP Request Smuggling.
summaryEn: Older versions of actix-http / actix-web contain request parsing flaws that can permit HTTP Request Smuggling.
remediationId: Perbarui crate actix-web dan actix-http ke versi 4.x terbaru.
remediationEn: Update actix-web and actix-http crates to the latest 4.x release.

summaryId: jQuery >= 1.2 dan < 3.5.0 rentan terhadap Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) saat melewatkan elemen HTML dari sumber tidak tepercaya ke metode manipulasi DOM seperti .html() atau .append().
summaryEn: In jQuery versions >= 1.2 and before 3.5.0, passing HTML from untrusted sources to DOM manipulation methods (e.g., .html(), .append()) may execute untrusted code.
remediationId: Perbarui pustaka jQuery ke versi 3.5.0 atau versi 3.7.1 terbaru.
remediationEn: Upgrade jQuery to version 3.5.0 or latest 3.7.x.

summaryId: jQuery sebelum 3.5.0 rentan terhadap XSS saat memproses elemen <option> dari sumber tidak tepercaya melalui metode DOM.
summaryEn: In jQuery versions before 3.5.0, passing HTML containing <option> elements from untrusted sources to DOM manipulation methods can execute untrusted code.
remediationId: Perbarui jQuery ke versi 3.5.0 atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Upgrade jQuery to version 3.5.0 or later.

summaryId: jQuery sebelum 3.4.0 rentan terhadap Prototype Pollution pada fungsi jQuery.extend(true, {}, ...).
summaryEn: jQuery before 3.4.0 mishandles jQuery.extend(true, {}, ...) leading to Object.prototype pollution.
remediationId: Upgrade jQuery ke versi 3.5.0+ atau 3.7.1.
remediationEn: Upgrade jQuery to version 3.5.0+ or 3.7.1.

summaryId: Bootstrap sebelum 3.4.1 dan 4.x sebelum 4.3.1 rentan terhadap XSS pada atribut data-template tooltip atau popover.
summaryEn: In Bootstrap before 3.4.1 and 4.x before 4.3.1, XSS is possible in the tooltip or popover data-template attribute.
remediationId: Perbarui Bootstrap ke versi 4.3.1+, 5.x, atau minimal 3.4.1.
remediationEn: Upgrade Bootstrap to version 4.3.1+, 5.x, or at least 3.4.1.

summaryId: WordPress sebelum 6.3.2 memiliki beberapa celah XSS dan pengungkapan komentar privat.
summaryEn: WordPress versions prior to 6.3.2 contain multiple XSS and comment disclosure vulnerabilities.
remediationId: Perbarui instalasi WordPress ke versi terbaru (6.5+).
remediationEn: Update WordPress core to the latest stable version (6.5+).

summaryId: Next.js sebelum 14.2.25 dan 15.2.3 memungkinkan bypass otorisasi Middleware melalui pengiriman header internal 'x-middleware-subrequest'.
summaryEn: Next.js versions prior to 14.2.25 and 15.2.3 allow bypassing Middleware authorization checks via a crafted 'x-middleware-subrequest' header.
remediationId: Upgrade Next.js ke >= 14.2.25 / 15.2.3 atau blokir header 'x-middleware-subrequest' di reverse proxy.
remediationEn: Upgrade Next.js to >= 14.2.25 / 15.2.3 or strip the 'x-middleware-subrequest' header at your reverse proxy.

summaryId: Next.js >= 13.4.0 dan < 14.1.1 rentan terhadap Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) melalui manipulasi header Host pada Server Actions.
summaryEn: Next.js versions >= 13.4.0 and < 14.1.1 are vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via Server Actions redirect handling.
remediationId: Upgrade Next.js ke versi 14.1.1 atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Upgrade Next.js to version 14.1.1 or later.

summaryId: Express.js sebelum 4.19.2 meneruskan URL yang telah di-encode sebagian ke res.location() atau res.redirect(), yang dapat memungkinkan Open Redirect bypass.
summaryEn: Express.js prior to 4.19.2 allows open redirect bypasses in res.location() and res.redirect() via malformed encoded URLs.
remediationId: Perbarui paket express ke >= 4.19.2.
remediationEn: Update the express package to >= 4.19.2.

summaryId: Django sebelum 4.2.11 dan 5.0.3 rentan terhadap Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) pada fungsi django.utils.text.Truncator.words().
summaryEn: Django before 4.2.11 and 5.0.3 is vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in django.utils.text.Truncator.words().
remediationId: Perbarui Django ke >= 4.2.11 atau 5.0.3+.
remediationEn: Update Django to >= 4.2.11 or 5.0.3+.

summaryId: Aplikasi Spring MVC / Spring WebFlux yang berjalan pada JDK 9+ (Spring4Shell) sebelum 5.3.18 / Spring Boot 2.6.6 rentan terhadap Remote Code Execution melalui data binding.
summaryEn: Spring MVC and Spring WebFlux applications running on JDK 9+ prior to 5.3.18 / Spring Boot 2.6.6 are vulnerable to RCE via data binding (Spring4Shell).
remediationId: Pastikan Spring Boot diperbarui minimal ke versi 2.6.6+ atau 3.x.
remediationEn: Ensure Spring Boot is updated to at least 2.6.6+ or 3.x.

summaryId: Fungsi BN_mod_sqrt() pada OpenSSL sebelum 1.1.1n dan 3.0.2 dapat masuk ke infinite loop saat memproses sertifikat dengan kurva eliptik yang dimodifikasi.
summaryEn: The BN_mod_sqrt() function in OpenSSL before 1.1.1n and 3.0.2 contains a bug that can cause it to loop forever for non-prime moduli when parsing certificates.
remediationId: Perbarui paket OpenSSL pada sistem operasi ke versi 1.1.1n+, 3.0.2+, atau lebih baru.
remediationEn: Update the OpenSSL system package to 1.1.1n+, 3.0.2+, or later.
